instruction: A cinematic medium shot of a sunny outdoor park with green grass and leafy trees. On the left, the woman with the afro (R6) in a red t-shirt and jeans smiles warmly. In the center, the East Asian man (R3) in a red polo shirt and a red patterned bandana smiles with clasped hands. On the right, the woman in the black beanie (R5) in a red t-shirt smiles. The woman with the afro and the woman in the beanie both drape an arm over the shoulders of the central East Asian man as they stand close together. Bright, natural sunlight filters through the trees, casting soft shadows.
elements: R6 drapes an arm over R3's shoulders
